description: This file contains Go code for generating Swagger documentation for Kubernetes API types, including functions for parsing Go source files, extracting documentation comments, and generating Swagger doc functions.

methods.name: astFrom
methods.description: Parses a Go source file and returns its documentation package.

methods.name: fmtRawDoc
methods.description: Formats raw documentation comments into a cleaned string suitable for Swagger documentation.

methods.name: fieldName
methods.description: Extracts the JSON field name from a struct field, considering tags.

methods.name: ParseDocumentationFrom
methods.description: Extracts documentation comments from all types in a source file, returning structured documentation info.

methods.name: WriteSwaggerDocFunc
methods.description: Generates Swagger documentation functions for given types and writes them to an io.Writer.

methods.name: VerifySwaggerDocsExist
methods.description: Checks for missing documentation in types and fields, writing results to an io.Writer.
